title: FNAF Yay! (Children)
blurb: Children cheering: the most wholesome noise imaginable, right up until you know where it came from. In Five Nights at Freddy's the cheer belongs to the death minigames and the lore hiding behind them, which means every FNAF player hears delight and dread in the same clip. That duality is exactly why the fandom loves it — the audio itself is entirely innocent, and the context ruined it permanently. Use it for genuinely lovely moments, for cursed ones, and above all for wholesome moments that are about to turn.
origin: The children's cheer from Five Nights at Freddy's — innocent until context.
